## createCategoricalColorScale() function

Deterministic, seeded categorical color assignment: the same category string always maps to the same color pair, both within a render and across reloads. Shared by every component that needs to color arbitrary category strings (amino acids, exon/transcript ids, taxon names, BLAST subject ids) — replaces what used to be two independent `randomColor()`<!-- -->+`Color()` call sites (GeneModel and PhyloTree) with subtly different contrast logic.
